description: Na₄LaGeSi₂PO₁₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic Cc space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.93 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.74 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.36 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.90 Å. La is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted LaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of La-O bond distances ranging from 2.22-2.44 Å. Ge is bonded to six O atoms to form GeO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Ge-O bond distances ranging from 1.92-2.24 Å. There are two inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent LaO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent GeO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 22-52°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.60-1.72 Å. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent LaO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent GeO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 23-46°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.59-1.73 Å. P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent LaO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent GeO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 20-48°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.52-1.59 Å. There are twelve inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one La, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one La, and one Si atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one La, and one Si atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Ge and one Si atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Ge, and one Si atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ge, and one P atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one La, and one Si atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to two Na, one La, and one Si atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to two Na, one La, and one P atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Ge, and one P atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Ge, and one Si atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Ge, and one Si atom.
